title: Communication & Personal Development

intro: Start with practical communication, then explore the reference collection while distinguishing source claims from established evidence.

groups.name: NLP reference
groups.description: Read the source terminology as an annotated reference, with evidence and scope notes.

notes: NLP in this collection means neuro-linguistic programming, distinct from natural language processing in AI.
Language and personality labels are descriptions from the collection, not diagnoses or fixed categories for judging people. Therapeutic claims are separated and discussed critically.

notes: Use the question bank flexibly rather than as a script. Respect a buyer’s refusal, preferences and confidentiality.

links.label: Read the evidence and therapeutic-claim notes

notes: The collection’s warning against rigid labels remains part of the reading path.
The 2012 Sturt et al. review reported limited evidence for NLP health outcomes and emphasized the quantity and quality of the research. It is not an evaluation of every term in this glossary.
The descriptions of trauma, addiction, eating and reprocessing methods are retained as source claims, not supplied as treatment instructions.

title: The Art of War: a guided reading collection
summary: Read all thirteen supplied chapters, with concise introductions and clearly separated business reflections.
intro: Read in chapter order or choose a theme. The historical text remains accessible in full; the modern reflections are editorial additions, not claims made by the original author.

groups.name: Strategy classics
groups.description: All thirteen supplied chapters, in reading order.

notes: This is historical military writing. Its descriptions of violence, deception and coercion are retained in context, not turned into business recommendations.

The supplied document does not name its translation or edition. A separate Lionel Giles edition is linked for comparison. Repeated passages are consolidated without removing unique content, and source positions remain mapped.
